claude_proposed_widenings.name: random_table ActivationPhase with attachment
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Prismatic Spray rolls 1d8 per creature in the area independently. The existing random_table ActivationPhase has no attachment field, making it impossible to express 'for each target in the cone, roll separately'. A bare random_table phase can only model a single global roll whose outcome applies to all affected creatures uniformly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: For each target, roll 1d8 to determine which color ray affects it

claude_proposed_widenings.name: RepeatSaveSpec: counted_outcome variant (threshold: N successes or N failures)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Indigo ray tracks cumulative Con save results independently — 3 successes end the Restrained condition; 3 failures replace it with permanent Petrified. The existing RepeatSaveSpec only supports onSuccess: 'ends_on_target' with no per-direction counting. The non-consecutive accumulation rule ('keep track of both until the target collects three of a kind') requires a new RepeatSaveSpec shape with separate success/failure counters and per-threshold outcomes.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If it successfully saves three times, the condition ends. If it fails three times, it has the Petrified condition until it is freed by an effect like the Greater Restoration spell. The successes and failures needn't be consecutive; keep track of both until the target collects three of a kind.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: RepeatSaveSpec cadence: start_of_caster_next_turn (one-shot)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Violet ray imposes Blinded and then fires a one-shot Wis save at the START of the CASTER's next turn. The existing RepeatSaveSpec cadences are end_of_target_turn and on_target_takes_damage — neither matches. on_caster_turn_start exists as an OngoingTrigger kind, but (a) the spell is instantaneous so ongoing_effect family is wrong, and (b) RepeatSaveSpec has no one-shot variant (it implies indefinite repetition until success).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Failed Save: The target has the Blinded condition and makes a Wisdom saving throw at the start of your next turn. On a successful save, the condition ends. On a failed save, the condition ends, and the creature teleports to another plane of existence (DM's choice).

claude_proposed_widenings.name: RandomTableOutcome: roll_again_meta variant
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Outcome 8 (Special) is not an effect — it directs the resolver to roll twice more on the same table, excluding 8. No RandomTableOutcome shape expresses recursive re-roll on the enclosing table. The phases array in RandomTableOutcome would need to contain nested random_table phases referencing the parent table, which is not representable in the current flat structure.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Special. The target is struck by two rays. Roll twice, rerolling any 8.
